name: WitCloud
description: Ask questions about your business and get answers straight from your own data - no spreadsheets, no waiting on a report. WitCloud connects Claude to all your marketing, sales, and ecommerce data in one place, so you can explore customers, campaigns, and revenue just by chatting. Claude understands the context of your business, so the answers actually make sense for you.

_published_faq.name: How do I add WitCloud to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add WitCloud to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.witcloud.ai/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the WitCloud MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: WitCloud lists 19 MCP tools, including add_context_log_entry, check_onboarding_step, complete_onboarding_step, describe_columns, get_business_context, get_channel_grouping, get_integration_status, get_onboarding_status, get_table_schema, list_data_sources, list_documents, and list_projects.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to WitCloud?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to WitCloud in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
WitCloud requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
WitCloud is developed by WitBee. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
